resources.string: Welcome to Blip
by Bitcoin Coast
The quickest way to take payments with the Blink wallet you already use.
Quiet scanner, quick results
It\'s working - even if you can\'t see the camera.
Blip scans in the background so checkout stays smooth. Aim at the code, wait a beat, and you\'re good.
Auto Pay, your rules
Pay small amounts instantly - no extra taps.
Set a limit you\'re comfortable with. For anything above it, Blip will ask before paying.
Your wallet stays your wallet
Blip is the checkout shortcut.
Connect the Blink wallet you already use. Blip focuses on fast in-person payments - everything else stays in your wallet.
Choose when Blip should ask for confirmation before paying.

Using Blip is at your own risk. This app connects to your own Lightning wallet - you are fully responsible for the funds in your wallet and any payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend connecting wallets with small spending balances.
Connect your Blink wallet
You'll connect using an API key from the Blink dashboard.
Go to
and log in with the same credentials you use in the Blink app.
Navigate to Settings then API keys.
Tap + to create a new key with all permissions enabled.
Copy the key that starts with
and come back here to paste it.
